pcs.pc_description: Ensure that all necessary tools and materials are on-site and organized
Set up ladders, scaffolding, and workstations as required.
Transport pipes, fittings, and tools to the work area.
Unload and organize materials from delivery trucks.
Understand and follow local building codes and regulations.
Clear and clean the work area.
Drill holes in walls, floors, and ceilings to accommodate pipes.
Use hangers and brackets to secure pipes in place
Store tools and unused materials neatly.
Read blueprints and drawings to determine exact specifications and where plumbing system will be installed.
Determine water supply networks and waste drainage systems.
Coordinate with project manager on installation.
Install systems used to transport water, waste, gases, or liquids.
Select all materials needed for installation, including type and size of pipe.
unpack pipes, fittings and fixtures as per manufacturer’s guidelines and safety measures
check quantity and quality of various plumbing materials and equipment present at the work site
Follow safety protocols and wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) such as gloves, goggles, and helmets.
Clean the work area after installations or repairs are complete.
report any shortcomings of supplies against specifications or requirements
follow the instructions received from head plumber or supervisor
Provide help in the installation of pipes and fixtures.
Assist in measuring, cutting, threading, and assembling new pipes.
Support in disassembling and removing damaged pipes or fixtures.
Install supports and hangers for pipe, fixtures and equipment.
Place the assembled pipes in hangers or other supports.
Assemble and install valves and fittings.
Cut openings in structures in preparation for pipes.
Cut pipes to required lengths using pipe cutters, saws, and pipe-cutting machines
Assist in diagnosing problems such as leaks or blockages.
Use basic tools to help locate the source of issues.
Help with pressure tests and other diagnostic procedures to ensure system integrity.
Assist in installing and maintaining plumbing systems.
Apply adhesives, sealants, and caulking to joints and pipe fittings.
Help install plumbing fixtures such as sinks, toilets, and showers.
Position fixtures and ensure they are level and secure
Connect fixtures to water and drainage lines under supervision.
Assist in testing installed systems for leaks and proper operation.
Assist in the maintenance and repair of plumbing systems and fixtures.
Assist in routing pipes through walls, floors, and ceilings
close or release water supply to the fixture and/or pipe being installed or repaired as per instructions of the plumber
use hand and power tools for cutting, bending and assembling pipes and fittings in a safe manner
perform cutting, bending and forming of different types of plastic, GI & SS pipes as per the dimensions marked by the plumber
assemble the fixture and/or pipework as per given instructions
secure the assembly using the fittings and fasteners as per instructions
hold the pipework or fixture steadily during installation for the plumber as and when required
Address basic customer questions and refer more complex inquiries to the supervising plumber.
clear work area and store tools and other plumbing materials safely and as per the specified guidelines
Assist in maintaining records of materials used and tasks completed.
Help with inventory management by tracking materials and tools used during projects.
Communicate with clients to provide updates on work progress.

pcs.pc_description: Clean and maintain plumbing tools and equipment.
Report any damaged or malfunctioning tools to the supervising plumber.
apply suitable treatment method to remove rust and corrosion from damaged tools
Wipe down tools like wrenches, pliers, and pipe cutters with a clean, dry cloth to remove dirt, grime, and moisture after each use.
Clean the exterior of an electrical tools with a damp cloth, avoiding electrical components.
Use compressed air to blow out dust and debris from vents and moving parts.
Inspect tools for any visible damage, such as cracks, chips, or worn-out parts
Perform functionality Test to ensure tools are operating correctly
Check for smooth operation, proper alignment, and effectiveness.
Apply appropriate lubricants to moving parts, such as joints and hinges, to ensure smooth operation and prevent rust.
Use manufacturer-recommended lubricants for power tools, particularly on parts that experience friction.
Perform deep Cleaning for tools that can be taken apart, disassemble them to clean hard-to- reach areas. Use brushes, cloths, and appropriate cleaning solutions.
Apply a rust-preventive solution to metal tools to protect against corrosion.
Sharpen blades, cutters, and other cutting tools using a file, sharpening stone, or an electric sharpener to maintain their effectiveness
Check for signs of wear and tear that might not be immediately visible. Pay attention to handles, grips, and power cords.
Ensure measuring tools and gauges are accurately calibrated.
Replace any missing or damaged tools.
Inspect and clean the motors of power tools, ensuring they are free from dust and debris.
Replace worn-out brushes and other components.
Check battery-operated tools, check battery health, clean contacts, and ensure proper charging practices.
Ensure tools are stored in an organized manner in toolboxes, racks, or shelves.
Use protective cases for delicate instruments.
Store tools in a dry, cool place to prevent rust and deterioration.
Ensure tools are used for their intended purposes to avoid unnecessary wear and damage.
Follow manufacturer guidelines and safety instructions.
Wear appropriate PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) such as gloves and safety glasses when cleaning and maintaining tools.
Disconnect power tools from the power source before performing any maintenance.
Provide training to all team members on proper tool usage and maintenance practices.
Keep maintenance logs to track the condition and maintenance schedules of tools.
Perform a comprehensive inventory check to ensure all tools are accounted for and in good condition.

Maintain good inventory of essential supplies like Clean, dry cloths and rags, Brushes and wire brushes, Appropriate cleaning solutions (non- corrosive), Lubricants, Rust-preventive solutions, Sharpening tools (files, sharpening stones), replacement parts (blades, brushes, belts)
Ensure the work area is free of hazards and clean up spills promptly.
Properly dispose of waste materials and debris.
Understand and comply with local building codes and safety regulations.
